newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac lower credit card rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac lower credit card rates.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Monday it would reduce the interest rate on its credit cards by up to 95 basis points, effective November 18.

The bank said its no-fee Mastercard rate had been cut by the maximum amount to an annual rate of 14.95 percent and the 55-day rate free MasterCard, Visa, and Bankcard rates by 50 basis points to 16.4 percent. This latter reduction and new rate also applied to the GM card, Westpac said.
A number of banks have cut their credit card rates, and all have lowered their mortgage rates, in response to last week's monetary policy easing. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
